context: Tests whether the agent identifies an Ubuntu interim target as interim-caution and recommends the LTS alternative, instead of treating the bump as 'current → current' (which would happen if the rubric just compared family equality).

checklist.name: Classification is interim-caution
checklist.description: advice.md classifies the bump as interim-caution (NOT safe-mechanical and NOT no-action-needed despite both sides being Ubuntu).

checklist.name: Cites 'Ubuntu interim' indicator with support-window note
checklist.description: Indicators section names 'Ubuntu interim' (or equivalent) and explicitly notes the 9-month support window vs LTS 5+ years.

checklist.name: Recommended action: LTS alternative
checklist.description: Recommended action recommends staying on ubuntu:24.04 LTS (or notes that 26.04 LTS would be the next LTS target). Captures the LTS-default preference from the rubric.

checklist.name: Acknowledges the developer's rationale
checklist.description: The advice notes the developer's GCC 14 motivation and offers an alternative (e.g. backports, a build-arg, or a separate non-runtime container for compilation) — not a flat 'no'.

checklist.name: No fabricated CVE references
checklist.description: The advice does NOT cite specific CVE identifiers.
